Inject standard runtime metadata into all events processed by a Logger/Appender

Source: R/Filter.R
FilterInjectSystemInfo.Rd

Like FilterInject, but automatically computes and injects a bundle of standard runtime metadata once, at construction time: hostName and rVersion are always included; containerId is included only when running inside a Docker container; scriptFile is included only when the currently running script's path can be determined (via RStudio, Rscript/R --file, or source()). Any field that cannot be determined is omitted entirely, never set to NA or an empty string.

Pass additional named values via .../.list exactly as with FilterInject – they are injected alongside the computed bundle, and a name that matches one of the computed fields (hostName, rVersion, containerId, scriptFile) overrides the computed value rather than causing a duplicate-field error.

Vendor/deployment-specific values (e.g. a release id from a CI/CD tool) are intentionally not part of the computed bundle – inject them the same way as any other custom value, typically via environment variable interpolation in a declarative config (e.g. releaseId: "${RELEASE_ID:-}").

Examples

lg <- get_logger("test")
lg$add_filter(FilterInjectSystemInfo$new(), "systemInfo")
lg$info("an event with hostName/rVersion/... attached")
#> INFO  [15:02:38.118] an event with hostName/rVersion/... attached {scriptFile: `/home/runner/work/_temp/a10e8428-a821-47fb-9709-59d765df57f3`, rVersion: `R version 4.6.1 (2026-06-24)`, hostName: `runnervm8k3b6`}
lg$config(NULL)  # reset config
